exemplars.title: Frequency Moments in Noisy Streaming and Distributed Data under Mismatch Ambiguity
exemplars.usage: Ordered p-clique sampling estimator with truncation controls expectation/variance (Hölder, Chebyshev, plus a Renyi-style inequality); DISJ communication-complexity reduction yields the space lower bound.
exemplars.quote: "Any O(1)-pass ((ϵ + Cηp), 0.48)-approximation algorithm for computing Fp on any noisy data stream of length up to m needs Ω(m^{1−1/p}/ϵ^{1/p}) bits of space."

exemplars.title: Towards Output-Optimal Uniform Sampling and Approximate Counting for Join-Project Queries
exemplars.usage: Hybrid heavy/light partition, Hoeffding intersection estimation, geometric search on OUT, Markov/Chebyshev median amplification, negative-hypergeometric rejection; coupon-collector reductions from listing hardness.
exemplars.quote: "any randomized algorithm that ... outputs an O(1) approximation of OUT with high probability requires at least Ω(N/√OUT) time."

exemplars.title: Representation Obliviousness and Pseudodeterminism in Streaming Algorithms
exemplars.usage: Reduction chain from ROPD F0 estimator to ROPD Promise-Union protocol to PD Disj protocol, contradicting CC(Disj)=Ω(m); canonical-value and output-distribution arguments.
exemplars.quote: "Let ε, δ ≤ 1/3. Any ROPD streaming algorithm that (ε, δ)-approximates F0 requires Ω(n) space (where n is the size of the universe)." (Thm 3.1)

exemplars.title: Deterministic Lower Bounds for k-Edge Connectivity in the Distributed Sketching Model
exemplars.usage: Probabilistic-method set families plus pigeonhole partitions create indistinguishable neighborhood pairs; reduction and a simulation of the sketching algorithm by the three parties transfer the hardness.
exemplars.quote: "Every deterministic algorithm that decides k-edge connectivity on n-node graphs in the distributed sketching model has a worst case message length of Ω(k) bits."
